subject: Senior ML Offer: approval path, relocation wording, and start-date options
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Senior ML - headcount approval + offer template (draft)

Markus — attaching the initial offer draft for the Senior ML Engineer (Sofiya Ramos). Please review the compensation band and a couple of clauses where I flagged options. TL;DR asks: (1) approve band & sign-on, (2) confirm relocation stipend approach, (3) approve conditional-start language for visa/clearance.

Key context: candidate is strong IC-3 level; recruiter has negotiated to the top of band but within budget if we approve a $30k sign-on. We have an open HC (HC-3891) that has manager approval; I need final leadership sign-off for the finance commit and to trigger People Ops to issue the DocuSign packet.

Items I flagged in the draft: 
- Base salary proposed: $210,000 (top of band). 
- Sign-on: two options shown: $30k lump-sum (one-time) OR $18k spread over 12 months (clawed back if voluntary exit within 12 months). Please indicate preference.
- Relocation: we currently offer a flat $7,500 stipend or reimbursement basis. Candidate is remote but willing to relocate; legal suggested changing 'relocation bonus' wording to 'relocation allowance' for clarity.
- Start date: Candidate preference is week of Nov 16 but they indicated Nov 20 in follow-up. We discussed a soft 'start escrow' language to allow for background/drug/customs clearance — basically a conditional start clause. I added draft wording but would appreciate legal phrasing if possible.
- Probation/90-day review: suggested language to be explicit about performance review and potential compensation adjustments.

Attachments: Senior_ML_Engineer_Offer_Draft_20261029.docx (redlines and inline comments).

Next steps: if you can reply with line-item approvals, I'll consolidate and send to People Ops. If you prefer, Marissa can hop on a 15-minute call with you this morning.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Hiring Manager, ML Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior ML - headcount approval + offer template (draft)

Priya — thanks for the clear summary. Quick notes inline below and a couple of firm asks.

- Band: approve $210,000 base as proposed. Good to stay consistent with our comps for IC-3.
- Sign-on: prefer the clawback structure ($18k over 12 months) rather than a large lump-sum. Less headline impact and easier for renewals/benchmarks.
- Relocation: change wording to 'relocation allowance' as legal suggested. Limit payout to actual documented moving expenses up to $7,500; do not give a pure cash 'bonus' to avoid tax/benefit complications.
- Conditional start: I want the candidate to have a firm tentative start (Nov 20) but with explicit conditionality that offer is contingent on standard background and I-9/authorization checks. For visa candidates, we typically include an additional clause about start being subject to visa issuance.
- Probation: keep 90-day performance review language but remove any mention of pay reduction — that creates tone issues. Make it a performance review with potential role/level calibration.

Legal/Finance asks (please loop in Laura for final wording and payroll handling): 
- Ensure sign-on clawback language is operable and includes examples of clawback schedule.
- Confirm whether the sign-on amortized over 12 months is processed via payroll (tax implications) or as an expense reimbursement.

If Laura confirms legal language, happy to sign off today. No need for an extra call.

Markus
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior ML - headcount approval + offer template (draft)

Thanks — quick operational notes from recruiting and candidate: 

- Candidate (Sofiya Ramos) confirmed Nov 20 as preferred start and is comfortable with a clawback schedule (would prefer the lump-sum but understands business reasons).
- Candidate is currently US-authorized (EAD pending renewal) — we will confirm I-9 docs before sending final offer. If EAD not active by start, we will use conditional-start wording.
- Candidate requests a one-time relocation reimbursement (receipts required) rather than a stipend; they estimate ~$6k moving costs. Per Markus's preference, we will cap at $7,500 and reimburse on submission of receipts.
- Background check: candidate agreed; typical 3–5 business day turnaround. We should not commit to start before checks clear.

I've attached an updated draft with tracked changes (Offer_SeniorML_v2.docx) that: 
- Changes sign-on to amortized $18k over 12 months with clawback schedule; 
- Rewords relocation to 'relocation allowance (reimbursement, receipts required, up to $7,500)'; 
- Adds conditional-start clause referencing background and I-9; 
- Softens probation language to '90-day performance review' and removes explicit pay reduction.

If Laura can confirm the legal wording on the clawback/repayment examples and payroll handling, I'm ready to send the DocuSign packet to the candidate by EOD tomorrow pending your sign-off.

Marissa
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Senior ML offer — consolidate and next steps

Thanks all — summarizing decisions so People Ops/Legal can action: 

1) Compensation: base $210,000, IC-3 band approved.
2) Sign-on: amortized $18,000 over 12 months with a 12-month clawback schedule (details to be finalized by Legal - Laura).
3) Relocation: reimbursement model; receipts required; cap $7,500. Wording: 'relocation allowance (reimbursement up to $7,500)'.
4) Start date: tentative Nov 20, 2026. Offer contingent on background/I-9; if EAD/visa not active candidate will have conditional-start clause.
5) Probation: 90-day performance review only — no pay-step reductions.

Laura — can you please: (a) confirm the clawback/repayment language and whether sign-on will be payroll-amortized or expense-processed, (b) check the relocation reimbursement wording for tax implications, and (c) approve final offer language for DocuSign?

Marissa — please prepare the DocuSign packet once Laura confirms and queue HC-3891 in Workday for the finance commit. I'll approve the final DocuSign send when Legal gives the green light.

I'll include the candidate on the outgoing offer email once DocuSign is ready. Candidate has expressed interest in a one-week remote onboarding window — include that in the offer addendum.

Thanks,
Priya
Hiring Manager, ML Platform
Redwood Inference
